description: Public keys for container image signature verification.
doc: Stores public key data (such as GPG keyrings or certificates) indexed by `certificate_thumbprint`, the lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the public key data, used by container image policies for signature verification.

mappings.description: Public key data for image signature verification.
mappings.doc: Binary public key data (e.g. x509 certificate) identified by `certificate_thumbprint`, the lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the public key data. Unsetting deletes the key from the device.
